Emitter.name: Emitter
Emitter.description:
✨ Your Quirk comes out of your body or acts on the world around you: flame, cold, electricity, force, light, sound, a substance or a pull.

🌱 You look ordinary until you use it, and control is what makes you safe to stand near.
⚠️ Eraser Head's Erasure switches your Quirk off while he looks at you.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Katsuki Bakugo (Explosion), Ochaco Uraraka (Zero Gravity), Momo Yaoyorozu (Creation).

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Control +5, Quirk Mobility +5, Quirk Analysis +5
⚡ Starting technique: Special Move Training
Emitter.traitNarrativeEffects:
Type: Emitter. Sends something out of the body or acts beyond it: energy, elements, force, substances, or an effect on what the user touches or sees.
Erasure: while Shota Aizawa (Eraser Head) looks at the user with his Quirk active (hair up, eyes red), the Quirk is off; what it already made or moved stays (ice, fire, a thrown object). It returns the instant his look breaks: a blink (more often the longer he holds it), smoke or a wall in the way, or he looks away. Other suppression: same, while it lasts.
Law: use in public or on a person without a hero license is illegal except self-defense or supervised (school, licensed work). Attacks are hard to hide; witnesses and police can usually trace a blast. Ordinary in a crowd; most know the Quirk only by registration and reputation.
Conflicts: one Quirk Type only; Quirkless overrides it; with No Quirk, bonuses only.
Look: ordinary at rest; shows only in use, where it leaves the body (palms, mouth, eyes, skin) and lands.
